question.text: Every real estate mutual fund scheme shall invest at least what percentage of net assets directly in real estate assets?

explanation.text: The Logic: Every real estate mutual fund scheme shall invest at least 35% of the net assets of the scheme directly in real estate assets. The Trap: 75% is the combined limit for real estate assets and related securities (mortgage-backed securities and equity/debentures of real estate companies), not the direct investment minimum. Note: Hold the contrast: 35% direct in real estate assets, 75% combined across real estate assets and related securities.
